text:
IncidentBot: deploy alert — service inference-api increased 5xx rate in us-west-2 canary. Auto-rollback triggered: rolled back 20% -> 0%, traffic now at 100% previous. Details: https://redwood.in/incident/2824681357 :rotating_light:

Jade (oncall): On it. Paging @Sam-dev and @Alex. Any quick root cause? Can we stop rollout entirely and flip kill-switch flag?

Sam-dev: saw spike on /v1/generate for seq_len>1024. Error pattern: OOM on model shard 2. I recommend feature-flag kill and manual rollback to v2.1. Cmd I'm running: 
```
./deploy rollback --service inference-api --to v2.1 --strategy hot-swap
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/inference-api
```

Ops Bot: autoscaler drained 2 pods in us-west-2, replaced with previous revision. rollout status: 2/3 updated, 3/3 available -> starting healthchecks.

Alex: Agree with kill-switch flip. Maria — want me to grab impact numbers while we hold? I'll run canary smoke and latency profilers.

Maria (product): Please. Customers on high-throughput plans may see 30-50% latency increase or timeouts. Standby comms: "We're reverting a deployment that introduced instability for high-length requests. No data loss expected." Keep me updated.

Jade (oncall): Flipping flag now: `FF_KILL_INFERENCE_CANARY=true` -> propagation started. @Sam-dev can you confirm the hot-swap completed and KV cache warm?

Sam-dev: hot-swap done. KV warm looks ok. Healthchecks:
`curl -sS https://us-west-2.api.redwood.com/health | jq .status` -> "ok"

Infra-Bot: rollback succeeded in us-west-2. Canary traffic back to baseline. Monitoring: errors dropped from 6.2% -> 0.4% in 3m.

Alex: Running smoke tests (short/long seq). All passes on v2.1 in us-west-2. Latency normalized. Will run a small synthetic workload 5m to be sure.

Jade (oncall): Good. Maria — drafting status update. Any customers to page now?

Maria (product): Pinging 2 customers on dedicated capacity with active long sequences. Template done, will send after final verification. :email:

Sam-dev: Follow-up postmortem todo: investigate shard memory accounting change in v3.0.1, add preflight to reject >1k seq when model variant not supported.

Jade (oncall): Closing incident thread once 15m stable and monitoring alerts clear. Leaving the flag in safe mode until patch. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: incident resolved? monitoring entering stable window. auto-close scheduled in 1h unless reopened.
